bin.headline: This Monday, 3 August — recycling and garden waste.

events.title: Cricket: final-Saturday double-header v Broadway
events.body: The season closes with both sides facing Broadway — the 1st XI away chasing promotion after a 233-run win over Moreton-in-Marsh, and the 2nd XI at home at The Lenches. Spectators warmly welcome for a big finale.

events.title: Bank Holiday weekend at The Lenches Club
events.body: The Club is open right across the bank holiday weekend with drinks promotions and the best view in the village — Saturday and Sunday from noon, and Monday noon to 10pm.

events.title: Free open-air cinema: How to Train Your Dragon — Lenches Amphitheatre
events.body: The free family matinee screening of the 2010 animated adventure (PG) is now sold out with a waiting list; if you have tickets you can't use, please email the theatre so they can be reallocated. Gates 4pm, film 5pm.

events.title: Sunset cinema: Good Morning, Vietnam — Lenches Amphitheatre
events.body: Free tickets are still available for this atmospheric evening screening of the 1987 Robin Williams classic (15). Gates 7.30pm, film 8.30pm; bring a rug or chairs, with the tearoom and bar open through the night.

events.title: Pershore Plum Festival: Plum Fayre Day — Pershore
events.body: The grand finale of the month-long Plum Festival, with the historic market town given over to stalls, food and family entertainment across the August bank holiday Monday.

events.title: Cash Bingo — The Lenches Club
events.body: Bring your friends, grab a bingo book and get dabbing. Ticket sales from 7.15pm, eyes down at 8pm; cash only and over-18s only.

events.title: Inter-Generation Tennis Funday — Lenches Tennis Club
events.body: A fun, all-ages tennis day in memory of Rod Stroud, open to everyone — no club membership needed. Any two people with an age gap can pair up; barbecue, cakes, drinks and prizes, with the emphasis firmly on fun. To take part, email lenchestc@gmail.com.

events.title: Sherlock Holmes and the Mystery of the Governor's Nose — Lenches Amphitheatre
events.body: Jenny Wren Productions bring the season's final outdoor performance to the amphitheatre — a newly written Sherlock Holmes mystery adapted from Conan Doyle. Gates 1pm, performance 2.30–4.30pm.

eventsFootnote: Weekly regulars: yoga at Abbots Morton Village Hall on Mondays (9.45am), Lenches Tennis Club cardio on Tuesdays (6.30pm), tai chi at Abbots Morton on Wednesdays (10am), and candlelight yoga at Rous Lench Village Hall on Thursdays (6.30pm). Encompass are also running children's tennis and multi-sport camps at the Tennis Club on Wednesdays and Thursdays through this final week of the summer holidays.

news.title: School applications open for September 2027
news.body: Applications for primary and secondary school places starting in September 2027 open on 1 September 2026 — worth noting the date if you have a child due to start or move up.

news.title: Pinvin bus service restored
news.body: After weeks of disruption during the Main Street gas works, the bus service through Pinvin towards Pershore and Worcester has now been reinstated.

news.title: Cricket club: new players welcome
news.body: With the season just ended, the club is already looking ahead — players of all ages and abilities are wanted, whether experienced, returning or brand new. Contact Venky on 07442 772470 or Charlie on 07775 660065.

notices.title: Newsletter deadline
notices.body: Got something for next week? Send it to website@thelenches.org.uk by the end of Wednesday.
